title: 🎙️ Studio 66 Podcast | Featuring Mayor Lana Negrete Part 1
description:
In this special episode, Mayor Lana Negrete joins Sgt. Ricky Verbeck on the Studio 66 Podcast as she reflects on her final days serving as Mayor of Santa Monica.

From championing local businesses and youth programs to navigating public safety challenges, Mayor Negrete discusses how she has "led with passion, accessibility, and an unwavering commitment to the community". Hear her candid thoughts on leadership, the realities of serving in public office, and what inspires her as she transitions into the next chapter.

👀 What’s Inside:
Growing up in Santa Monica
Her Introduction to Santa Monica's City Council
Passing the baton to Mayor Pro-Tem Caroline Torosis

Stay tuned for Part 2 where Mayor Negrete discusses:
Lessons learned through community service
How partnerships with SMPD shaped safety initiatives
& What’s next for her!
